set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Read-only kernels can consume owned, borrowed, and mutable sources through the ownership-neutral source abstraction.
- Destination ownership, overlap, and alias rules remain explicit and are checked before mutation.
- Mutable reshapeCopy performs exactly one output-sized materialization.
- Noncontiguous mutable reshape fallback also performs at most one output-sized copy.
- Allocation tests cover canonical and noncontiguous reshapes plus ping-pong mutable source use.
- Stencil source overload duplication is reduced only where the ownership contract stays clear.
set.title: Accept mutable read sources and remove mutable reshape double copying
